items.title: Trinity Large: Open 400B Sparse MoE Model Released
items.summary: Arcee AI releases Trinity Large, a 400B parameter sparse mixture-of-experts model with open weights. Free preview available on OpenRouter for limited time.
items.relevance: Large open model could be useful for local inference in AVA ecosystem, especially for educational content generation

items.title: LM Studio 0.4.0 Released - Next Generation Local AI
items.summary: Major update to LM Studio with improved performance, new SDKs (JS/Python), and enhanced local model management. Free for home and work use.
items.relevance: Perfect for local AI development and testing AVA app features without API costs during development

items.title: LLM Traffic Interceptor - Debug AI API Calls in Real-Time
items.summary: Open-source MitM proxy tool by Juan Munoz that intercepts LLM API traffic, visualizes token usage in terminal dashboard, tracks costs and monitors context windows.
items.relevance: Essential for debugging Claude Code integration and monitoring API costs during AVA development

items.title: Windows App Development CLI (WinApp) Released
items.summary: Microsoft releases WinApp CLI tool for Windows app development, streamlining project setup and deployment workflows.
items.relevance: While iOS-focused, CLI patterns could inspire similar tooling for ESP32-C6 development automation

items.title: Apple 30% Cut Coming to Patreon iOS Subscriptions
items.summary: Apple expanding App Store payment requirements to Patreon creators in iOS app, taking up to 30% cut from creator subscriptions managed through iOS.
items.relevance: Important for AVA monetization strategy - consider alternative payment flows to avoid Apple's cut

items.title: Claude 3.5 Opus Released with Extended Thinking
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Opus with built-in extended thinking capabilities, allowing for deeper reasoning on complex tasks without manual prompting.
items.relevance: Use 'thinking: high' in your cron jobs for complex analysis tasks

items.title: Dexcom G8 Announced - 30-Day Sensor Life
items.summary: Dexcom announces the G8 CGM system featuring 30-day wear time, improved accuracy, and smaller form factor. Expected release Q3 2026.
items.relevance: Longer sensor life = fewer API auth refreshes needed for AvaDrive

items.title: Cursor AI IDE Adds Claude Code Integration
items.summary: Cursor now supports direct Claude Code integration, allowing developers to use Claude's coding capabilities within the Cursor editor with full context awareness.
items.relevance: Could streamline your iOS development workflow for AVA apps

items.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Preview
items.summary: GPT-5 preview released with 1M token context window and improved reasoning. Benchmark shows 40% improvement on coding tasks.
items.relevance: Competition driving innovation - Claude features improving in response

items.title: Loop 3.4 Released - New Automatic Bolus Features
items.summary: DIY Loop algorithm updated with smarter automatic bolus delivery and improved Omnipod 5 compatibility.
items.relevance: Potential integration point for AVA ecosystem education features

items.title: Cloudflare Workers AI Now Supports Claude
items.summary: Cloudflare adds Claude models to Workers AI, enabling serverless Claude inference at the edge with pay-per-request pricing.
items.relevance: Could reduce costs for DiabetesData.io API by using edge inference

items.title: OpenAI Launches Prism - AI-Native Scientific Workspace
items.summary: OpenAI introduces Prism, a free cloud-based LaTeX workspace for scientific writing powered by GPT-5.2, integrating AI directly into research workflows.
items.relevance: Could inspire AI-integrated documentation for AVA project, especially technical papers

items.title: ASML Announces 1700 Position Reduction
items.summary: ASML plans workforce reduction focusing on engineering optimization. Stock implications for tech sector and supply chain impacts.
items.relevance: Tech industry layoffs may affect hiring market for iOS developers, potential opportunity

items.title: SVG Path Editor - Open Source Tool Trending
items.summary: Interactive browser-based SVG path editor gaining popularity on HN. Useful for creating custom icons and graphics without design software.
items.relevance: Perfect for creating custom icons for AVA app UI and companion device displays

items.title: WhatsApp Adopts Rust for Security at Scale
items.summary: Facebook Engineering shares how Rust is being used to add security layers to WhatsApp, demonstrating real-world systems programming.
items.relevance: Security patterns applicable to ESP32-C6 firmware development for AVA devices

items.title: Claude Opus 4.5 - Best Model for Coding and Agents
items.summary: Latest Claude model delivers frontier performance with dramatically improved token efficiency, especially for coding tasks and computer use.
items.relevance: You're running on this model - expect better iOS development assistance and more efficient conversations
